`449-455`: _📐 Maintainability & Code Quality_ | _🔵 Trivial_ | _⚡ Quick win_ **Cover the new `agentic-skills` payload dispatch.** The updated controller tests validate the image passed directly to `getAgenticRuns`, but they do not prove that `InitializeFromPayload` propagates a payload’s `agentic-skills` DockerImage tag through `SetSkillsImage`. Add or verify a `pkg/cvo/cvo_test.go` case covering both image tags and a non-DockerImage tag so this routing regression cannot silently pass.

Use the existing InitializeFromPayload test patterns and agenticRunController test double. ```
